title: End-to-End Record Pipeline Tests
requirements: Write a stub/fake AudioRecorder (conforming to an injected protocol) that returns a fixed small .m4a fixture file URL from stop() without requiring a real microphone

Write an integration test that drives RecordingViewModel through start() → brief wait → stop(), asserts completedEntry is non-nil, then calls ListViewModel.finishRecording(entry:) and asserts the resulting DiaryEntry appears in the timeline (store.entries())
Verify onCompleted is invoked with the persisted DiaryEntry and ListViewModel.isRecording resets to false
No real microphone, no real network: use fixture .m4a and a stubbed TranscriptionService that returns a deterministic TranscriptUpdate.final
Run in <2 seconds; mark @MainActor on the test class where applicable
acceptance_criteria: One end-to-end pipeline test in CI drives start→stop→finalize→persist and asserts a persisted DiaryEntry
Test runs in <2 seconds without microphone or network access
Test is isolated to a temp directory (NSTemporaryDirectory) and cleans up in tearDown
